user.title: Zendure Local Pilot
user.description: Enter the address of the Shelly Pro 3EM that runs the regulation script. The battery itself is discovered automatically by the script.

data.migrer: Take over the entities from the YAML version

data_description.migrer: Keep this enabled when upgrading from the YAML packages: it preserves your history and statistics. Remove the YAML packages first.

error.injoignable: No answer from this address. Check the IP and that the Shelly is powered.
error.pas_un_shelly: This device answered, but it is not a Shelly.
error.script_absent: No Zendure regulation script was found on this Shelly. Install it first, otherwise there is nothing to supervise.

packages_yaml_encore_charges.title: The YAML packages are still loaded
packages_yaml_encore_charges.description: {nombre} entities had to fall back to an identifier ending in _2, because the YAML packages still own the original ones. Your history and dashboards point at the old entities, which no longer update. Remove the zendure_solarflow4000mix*.yaml files from your packages folder, restart Home Assistant, then reload this integration.

set_power.name: Power setpoint
set_power.description: Forces a power setpoint. Positive discharges to the house, negative charges from the grid, zero idles. The value is clamped by the Maximum discharge and Maximum charge sliders. Volatile write: if the Shelly regulation is running, it takes over on the next cycle.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Only needed when several batteries are configured.

set_limits.name: Inverter limits
set_limits.description: Writes the discharge and charge limits. Stored in flash memory: do not call this in a loop.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Only needed when several batteries are configured.

set_soc.name: Charge limits
set_soc.description: Writes the SOC limits. The firmware scale (percent or per-mille) is detected automatically. Stored in flash memory.

min_soc.name: Minimum SOC
min_soc.description: Level below which the battery stops discharging.

max_soc.name: Maximum SOC
max_soc.description: Level above which the battery stops charging.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Only needed when several batteries are configured.

write_properties.name: Write properties
write_properties.description: Sends raw properties to the battery, with no interpretation. An escape hatch for zenSDK properties this integration does not expose yet. Handle with care.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Only needed when several batteries are configured.

reset_health.name: Reset the health estimate
reset_health.description: Clears the measured pack capacities and their reference points. The measurement restarts on the next cycle of at least 25 SOC points.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Only needed when several batteries are configured.

redeploy_script.name: Redeploy the Shelly script
redeploy_script.description: Rewrites the regulation script from a local file, in chunks, then reads it back in full and compares. The Shelly web editor silently truncates large scripts; this service does not.

chemin.name: File path
chemin.description: Path to the script, inside a directory allowed by allowlist_external_dirs.
